vs_stocks_note: The 364-day T-bill now yields 15.85% against August inflation of 15.39%. The risk-free return barely beats inflation. Falling T-bill yields (as now) usually make equities look more attractive, since the 'safe' alternative pays less. Rising yields do the opposite.

tax.note: FIRS directive of October 2025: 10% withholding tax deducted at source on T-bill interest; FGN bond interest remains exempt. Investors receive tax credits for amounts withheld.
